title: Group Actions, Fixed Points and Orbit Quotients in Lipschitz Spaces
summary: We study Lipschitz mappings associated with group actions by similarities, extending the orbit-quotient approach for point-preserving isometric actions. Normalizing by the similarity ratios we obtain isometric representations whose fixed points are character-equivariant Lipschitz mappings. The corresponding quotients by closed spans of orbit differences provide canonical preduals and norm-preserving linearizations, without an amenability assumption.
